header.explicit_non_claim: This candidate fixture does not prove that any transaction, ENS record, hash input, calldata publication, or on-chain anchor exists.

narrative.title: DEPARTMENT OF JUSTICE — STORY FORM, LIVE FROM THE ARCHIVES
narrative.scene: The auditing library is represented as a glass cube in an evidence vault. The imagery explains evidence hashing and receipt chaining; it is not a factual description of a DOJ system.

characters.name: Jay
characters.note: The operator is not the audit subject. The rubric and evidence transitions are the subjects.

characters.name: The Auditor
characters.note: Observes, evaluates supplied evidence, replays bounded functions, and emits non-authoritative receipts.

control_crawl_adapter.interface_claim: crawl(bytes32 cell_id, CrawlContext memory context) external returns (bool pass, bytes32 proof_delta, bytes32[] memory next_cells)
control_crawl_adapter.determinism_requirement: Given identical canonical cell_id and context bytes, an authorized implementation must produce byte-identical outputs.

bidirectional_seal_test.success_condition: Every sampled reverse replay must reconstruct the exact canonical comparison target defined by the rubric.

magic_ball_output.next_best_audit_question: Which original bytes, transaction receipt, chain identifier, block number, and inclusion proof would establish or falsify the claimed genesis anchor?
